description: Three independent defects visible in the single response block: (1) broken escaping from the AsciiDoc-to-Markdown conversion - the block opens with '$lt; HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable', a mangled <, and ends with a stray shell prompt '$'; (2) the error code was never filled in, showing the literal placeholder '"code": <int>' where every other error example in the directory gives a real code; (3) the block is hand-indented inside a `console` fence, unlike the clean `json` fences used by every sibling example page.
